page.overview:
Who is Martian Emperor?

Execute the Shapesmith for causing the Sequids to attack them. (failed)

The Martian Emperor is one of the minor characters in Invincible. He is the current ruler of Mars.

His backstory is largely unknown, except becoming the current emperor of all Martians.

At some point during or before the Martian Emperor's reign, a spaceship carrying a race of parasitic creatures called Sequids crashed on Mars. With their original hosts killed in the crash, the Sequid hive mind became disorganized. They attempted to possess the Martians, but the latter's shape-changing abilities enabled them to resist the Sequids. The Martians would then use the Sequids as servants, but remained cautious if they were ever to possess a non-Martian.
